gloss: hale and hearty, vigorous in old age

definitions.gloss: hale and hearty, vigorous in old age
definitions.explanation: Describes elderly people who remain energetic, healthy, and mentally sharp despite their advanced age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧90⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{矍鑠|かくしゃく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is hale and hearty even at 90.

examples.japanese: {矍鑠|かくしゃく}たる⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A vigorous old man jogs every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧80⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}えない→思う：00492_omou⟧ほど{矍鑠|かくしゃく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She is so hale and hearty you wouldn't believe she's in her 80s, tending to her garden every day.

notes:
A literary and somewhat formal term used to praise elderly people who remain mentally and physically vigorous.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {矍鑠|かくしゃく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is hale and hearty)
- {矍鑠|かくしゃく}たる〜 (hale and hearty ~, literary)
- {矍鑠|かくしゃく}とした⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧ (a vigorous elderly person)

USAGE:
This is a complimentary term exclusively used for elderly people. The kanji are rare and difficult, so the word is often written in hiragana. It conveys admiration for those who defy the typical expectations of aging.
